description:
All hired employees are expected to have experience with Microsoft Copilot and / or an approved equivalent AI solution. 

 Description 
DSA is in search of an exceptionally skilled Power Platform Developer with extensive Power BI development experience possessing a secret clearance. This position is a hybrid role reporting to the Pentagon one day per week.

 Required Qualifications 

 
 Highly proficient in data visualization design/data modeling/data science

 Highly proficient in development of Power BI solutions

 Proficient in Power Apps and Power Automate solution development

 Proficient in SharePoint Online (SPO)

 Experience with Army 365 (A365) or Microsoft Office 365

 Solid understanding of requirements gathering process and customer engagement

 CompTIA Security + CE certification (Certification preferred upon hire but must be acquired within 90 days for otherwise well qualified candidates)

 Computing Environment (CE) relative to the position (EX: Microsoft Power Platform 100, 200, or 400 other related certifications can be considered) - Certification preferred upon hire but can be acquired within 180 days for otherwise well qualified candidate)

 
  

 Clearance Required 

 
 Active or Current DOD Secret Clearance

 
  

 Desired Qualifications 

 
 Experience managing Power BI Premium Workspaces

 Project management experience including requirements gathering, customer engagement, and formaldocumentation of efforts

 Microsoft Office skills especially PowerPoint

 Experience with Power BI and SharePoint in the US Army unclassified network or DoD environment

 Experience using project management tools e.g. MS Project and JIRA

 Understanding of agile and waterfall software development models

 Experience with data lakes such as Army Vantage

 Proficient with Model-Driven app development and Dataverse

 Experience with MS Power Suite, including Power Apps and Power Automate

 
 Key Responsibilities 

 
 Define, model, and deliver connections to standard Army data sources

 Establish and maintain connections through the data gateway, create ETL as required and utilize Dataverse and data warehouses as needed

 Design and deliver common dashboards/reports

 Evolve the existing data framework platform to provide enterprise repeatable capabilities

 Power BI solution development

 Power BI Premium Workspace management

 Data model development

 Alignment of SharePoint Online, M365, SharePoint and other solutions to data model

 Building data environment to support existing and emerging data visualization and metrics requirements

 Working with customers to define and document requirements

 Stakeholder communications including formal and informal presentations

 Develop data visualization solutions

 Define and communicate technical project plans, roadmaps, and schedules

 Creation of dashboards/Business Intelligence (BI) based on key performance indicators and customer requirement

 
 #DSA209

 #LI-CW1
 The posted salary range is a good-faith estimate. Actual compensation will be based on the selected candidate’s qualifications, experience, skills, and other job-related factors. 
 

 DSA - Salary Pay Range
 $120,000 — $138,000 USD 


 Many of DSA's positions require the ability to obtain a security clearance. Security clearances may only be granted to U.S. citizens. In addition, applicants who accept a conditional offer of employment may be subject to government security investigation(s) and must meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information. DSA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. DSA is committed to treating all employees and applicants for employment with respect and dignity and maintaining a workplace that is free from unlawful discrimination. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, national origin, disability, veteran status, or other legally protected status. DSA requires background checks , where permitted , by law. DSA is an E-Verify Employer.
